blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Analysis of fibrous structures in SEM images is a routine task in biomedical engineering and materials science. However, most available methods for fiber quantification still rely on classical image binarization followed by simple post-processing. These approaches often produce unreliable results in images with weak boundaries, heterogeneous contrast, and densely packed fibers. Here, we introduce Fiberpose, a framework that reformulates fiber analysis as direct regression of a smooth distance-transform (DT) field, together with a novel set of geometry-based algorithms specifically adapted to this representation. The predicted field directly encodes fiber geometry, while the accompanying algorithms enable instance reconstruction and measurement of diameter and orientation within a unified workflow. The framework is implemented as a standalone Python desktop application and a web tool https://fiberpose.org. On an independent dataset of fibrous SEM images, Fiberpose achieved state-of-the-art instance-segmentation accuracy in comparison with SAM2 and Cellpose-SAM, and more accurate diameter measurements than DiameterJ, Fibar and GIFT. The method remains effective in dense and weakly contrasted regions and shows qualitative generalization across microscopy modalities not represented in the training data. Fiberpose therefore provides an interpretable geometric representation and an automated pipeline for reproducible quantitative characterization of fibrous materials.
blocks.zh: SEM图像中的纤维结构分析是生物医学工程和材料科学中的一项常规任务. 然而,大多数可用的纤维量化方法仍然依赖于古典图像二进制,然后是简单的后处理. 这些方法往往产生不可靠的结果,造成边界薄弱、对比不一和纤维密集的图像。 在这里,我们引入了Fiberpose,这个框架将纤维分析重新定型为平滑相距-变形(DT)场的直接回归,以及一套专门针对这种表示的以几何为主的算法. 所预测的字段直接将纤维几何编码,而相伴随的算法则可以在一个统一的工作流程内对直径和方向进行实例重建和测量. 该框架作为一个独立的Python桌面应用程序和一个网络工具https://fiberpose.org来实施. 在纤维SEM图像的独立数据集上,比起SAM2和Cellpose-SAM,Fiberpose实现了最先进的实例分解精度,并比DiameterJ,Fibar和GIFT更精确地进行了直径测量. 该方法在密集和弱对比的区域依然有效,在培训数据中没有体现的显微镜复制方式中显示出定性的概括。 因此,纤维提供了可解释的几何表示和可复制纤维材料定量定性的自动化管道。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Microscopic analysis of fiber morphology is a fundamental and routine task in both the life and materials sciences. In biology, fibrous structures are found at every scale, from cytoskeletal filaments, through the collagen and elastin networks of the extracellular matrix, to the cellulose microfibrils of plant cell walls, and their organization shapes tissue mechanics and cell behavior. In engineering, fibers are equally widespread: textiles, paper, fiber-reinforced composites, filtration media, and electrospun scaffolds for tissue engineering all derive their strength, stiffness, permeability, and biological response from the arrangement of their fibers. Despite these different contexts, the same quantitative descriptors are needed: fiber alignment, diameter distribution, and porosity link structure to function, but they are useful only if they can be measured consistently across imaging modalities and spatial scales.
blocks.zh: 对纤维形态的微观分析是生命和材料科学中一项基本和例行的任务。 在生物学中,纤维结构在每一个尺度上都有发现,从细胞骨骼丝,通过细胞外基质的细胞质网和弹性网,到植物细胞壁的纤维素微纤维,其组织形成组织力学和细胞行为. 在工程学中,纤维同样广泛:纺织品,纸张,纤维强化复合材料,过滤介质,以及组织工程用的电spun脚手架都通过纤维的排列来获得其强度,硬度,渗透性,以及生物反应. 尽管有这些不同的背景,但需要同样的量化描述符:纤维对齐,直径分布,以及孔径连接结构与功能,但只有能够在成像方式和空间尺度之间一致地测量它们才有用.

blocks.en: Over the past decade, more than twenty dedicated software tools have been developed to automate quantitative analysis of fibers across microscopy modalities [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Despite differences in implementation, most methods rely on classical image-processing techniques, such as Otsu thresholding [ 5 ] , statistical region merging (SRM) [ 6 ] , or edge detection, followed by post-processing steps such as skeletonization and contour analysis. For example, DiameterJ [ 7 ] and Gordium [ 8 ] use binarization as an initial step, whereas GIFT [ 9 ] employs Sobel edge detection. While effective for clean, high-contrast images, these methods fail when confronted with low signal-to-noise ratios and variable illumination. A more fundamental limitation does not depend on image quality: binary semantic representations cannot distinguish individual fibers at contacts and intersections, introducing ambiguities that can propagate into artifacts during subsequent morphological analysis, particularly in densely packed networks with overlapping fibers. Thus, the main bottleneck of currently available fiber analysis methods lies not only in the quality of binarization but in the binary representation itself.
blocks.zh: 在过去的十年中,开发了20多个专用软件工具,对各种显微复制模式的纤维进行自动化定量分析[1、2、3、4]。 尽管执行上存在差异,但大多数方法都依赖于古典图像处理技术,如大津阈值[5],统计区合并(SRM)[6],或边缘检测,然后是骨架化和轮廓分析等处理后步骤. 例如,DiameterJ[7]和Gordium[8]将二进制作为第一步,而GIFT[9]则使用 索贝尔边缘探测。 这些方法虽然对清洁的高混凝土图像有效,但在面对低信号对噪音比率和可变照明时却失败了。 更根本的限制并不取决于图像质量:二进制语义表示法无法区分接触和交叉处的单个纤维,在之后的形态分析中引入模糊不清,可以传播到文物中,特别是在纤维重叠的密集包裹的网络中. 因此,目前可用的纤维分析方法的主要瓶颈不仅在于二进制的质量,而且在于二进制表述本身。

blocks.en: Several deep-learning approaches have been proposed for fibrous structures, but most of them replace the binarization step without changing the representation. Semantic segmentation architectures, such as U-Net and DeepLabV3+ [ 10 , 11 ] , substitute a learned classifier for thresholding, yet they produce the same kind of binary mask and therefore do not distinguish individual fibers at intersections or regions of overlap. Approaches that address fiber identity directly, such as Mask R-CNN and YOLOv8 instance segmentation [ 11 , 12 ] or U-Net-based segmentation followed by fiber tracing [ 13 ] , have so far been demonstrated only on dispersed, individually resolvable filaments and are not suited to densely entangled networks containing numerous intersecting fibers. Interactive approaches, such as FiberDiameter [ 14 ] , enable measurements of selected fibers but are less suitable for automated whole-image analysis. Thus, learned segmentation, instance separation and fiber tracing have each been demonstrated, but only for dispersed fibers, and measurements are still derived from the resulting masks. What is still missing is a framework that provides both instance segmentation and quantitative morphometry for densely packed fibrous networks, across various materials, image qualities and fiber densities.
blocks.zh: 为纤维结构提出了若干深入学习的办法,但大多数办法取代二进制步骤而不改变代表性。 语义分解架构,如U-Net和DeepLabV3+[10,11],用一个学习的分解器代替了阈值分解,然而它们却产生同一种二进制面具,因此在交叉点或重叠区域不区分单个纤维. 直接处理纤维特性的方法,如Mask R-CNN和YOLOv8实例分解[11,12]或U-Net基分解,然后是纤维追踪[13],迄今为止这些方法只在分散的、可单独解的丝片上展示,并不适合含有许多交叉纤维的密集缠绕网络。 交互式方法,如纤维测量仪[14],能够测量选定的纤维,但不太适合自动进行全像分析。 因此,已经证明,每个地方都有经过学习的分化、实例分离和纤维追踪,但仅针对分散的纤维,测量结果仍然来自由此产生的面具。 仍然缺少的是一个框架,为各种材料、图像质量和纤维密度的密集纤维网络提供实例分解和定量的畸形。

blocks.en: Recent advances in neural segmentation have shown that convolutional encoder–decoder architectures such as U-Net [ 15 , 16 ] can be adapted for instance segmentation in crowded scenes by predicting continuous geometric fields followed by post-processing, rather than relying solely on thresholded foreground probabilities. In cell image analysis, Cellpose [ 17 ] and Omnipose [ 18 ] predict a vector field for each image and recover instances by following it: pixels whose paths along the field converge to the same location are grouped into one object. In Cellpose, and in its extension with a vision-transformer backbone, Cellpose-SAM [ 19 ] , the field points toward cell centers, which becomes increasingly ambiguous for elongated structures and can lead to segmentation failures. In Omnipose, the field is the gradient of a distance field and points toward the medial axes of cells, enabling more robust segmentation of elongated and irregularly shaped instances. Yet Omnipose was developed and trained on images of bacteria and worms; the medial axes are never explicitly reconstructed or used as a geometric representation, and the framework provides no quantitative measurements of object geometry. For fibers and other objects with a high aspect ratio, however, the distance transform (DT) can serve as an explicit geometric representation in its own right: the same field that separates touching instances [ 20 ] also encodes the medial axis and local width of each object [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 神经分裂的最新进展表明,像U-Net [15,16] 这样的革命编码器-解码器架构可以通过预测连续几何字段,然后进行后处理,而不是仅仅依靠阈值前缘概率来调整,比如在拥挤的场景中进行分割. 在细胞图像分析中,Cellpose [17] 和 OMNIPOSE [18] 为每个图像预测一个矢量场,并通过遵循它来恢复实例: 其沿场路径汇合到同一位置的像素被组合成一个对象. 在Cellpose, 以及扩展的视觉转换主干线Cellpose-SAM[19]中,野外指向细胞中心,对于较长的结构来说,这越来越模糊不清,并可能导致分裂失败. 在Ommipose中,球场是距离场的梯度,指向细胞的中间轴,从而能够更强烈地分割长长和不规则的形状。 然而,Ommipose是针对细菌和蠕虫的图像开发和训练的;介质轴从未被明确重建或用作几何表示,框架也没有提供物体几何的定量测量. 然而,对于光纤和其他具有高宽比的物体,距离变换(DT)本身可以作为明确的几何表示: 将触碰实例分开的同一字段[20] 也编码每个物体的中间轴和局部宽度[21].

blocks.en: Here, we introduce Fiberpose , a deep-learning-based framework that combines instance segmentation and quantitative morphometry of fibers through a common representation: the DT field and its ridges. It deliberately builds on two established ideas: the prediction of continuous geometric fields by a convolutional encoder–decoder network, as in Cellpose and Omnipose, and the distance transform that conventional fiber analysis tools, such as DiameterJ [ 7 ] , compute from a binarized image. Fiberpose instead predicts the DT field directly from the original microscopy image, using a neural network trained on a curated dataset of diverse SEM images. This avoids error-prone binarization and enables a more reliable recovery of fiber geometry under challenging imaging conditions, including weak boundaries, heterogeneous contrast, and densely packed structures. Morphometry is performed directly on the predicted field and does not require successful instance segmentation. To exploit this representation, we developed a suite of geometric algorithms for centerline extraction, instance reconstruction, local diameter and orientation measurements, and assessment of measurement reliability. The contribution of this work therefore lies in the adaptation of individual components and their integration into a complete pipeline from the raw image to quantitative measurements, provided as freely available software through both a standalone desktop application and a web-based tool. Fiberpose demonstrated higher measurement accuracy than the evaluated morphometry methods, as well as higher recall and precision than the evaluated instance segmentation methods.
blocks.zh: 在此,我们介绍Fiberpose,一个以深入学习为基础的框架,通过一个共同代表点,即DT领域及其山脊,将纤维的实例分化和定量分泌结合起来。 它刻意以两个既定的想法为基础:通过一个革命编码器–解码器网络(如Cellpose和Ommipose)对连续几何字段的预测,以及距离改变这种传统的纤维分析工具,如DiameterJ [7],从二进制图像中计算. Fiberpose则直接从原始的显微镜图像中预测DT场,使用在多种SEM图像的编译数据集上训练的神经网络. 这避免了容易发生误差的二进制化,并使得纤维几何学在具有挑战性的成像条件下能够更可靠地恢复,这些成像条件包括边界薄弱,对比不一,结构密集。 morphometry直接在预测的字段上进行,不需要成功的实例分割. 为了利用这种表述,我们开发了一套几何算法,用于中线提取、实例重建、局部直径和定向测量以及测量可靠性评估。 因此,这项工作的贡献在于调整各个部件,将它们纳入从原始图像到定量测量的完整管道中,通过独立的桌面应用程序和网络工具作为免费软件提供。 Fiberpose的测量精度高于经评估的测尸方法,而且比经评估的实例分解方法更能召回和精确。

blocks.en: Framework overview
blocks.zh: 框架概览

blocks.en: General architecture and terminology
blocks.zh: 一般结构和术语

blocks.en: Fiberpose converts a raw microscopy image (Fig. 1 a, INPUT ) into a geometric representation of the fiber network. First, a neural network predicts a distance-transform (DT) field, in which each foreground pixel encodes its estimated distance to the nearest fiber boundary. In this representation, fiber centerlines correspond to the ridges of the DT field, which reaches a local maximum along the direction perpendicular to the fiber. Fiberpose traces the candidate ridges and groups them into uniquely identified FiberFragments . Geometrically derived rules are then applied to filter the candidate ridges, and the retained ones serve as measurement centerlines for quantitative morphometry (Fig. 1 b,c, REPRESENTATION ).
blocks.zh: Fiberpose将原始显微镜图像(图1 a,INPUT)转换成纤维网络的几何代表. 首先,一个神经网络预测一个距离变形(DT)字段,其中每个前方像素将其估计距离编码到最近的纤维边界. 在这个表示法中,纤维中心线与DT场的脊相对应,沿与纤维垂直的方向达到局部最大. Fiberpose追踪候选脊, 然后将几何衍生规则用于过滤候选山脊,保留山脊作为定量摩擦测量的测量中心线(图1b,c, 代表.)。

blocks.en:
This representation supports three ANALYSIS steps (Fig. 1 d–f). First, instance segmentation post-processes the DT field and candidate ridges to produce labeled fiber fragments.
In the second, independent step, Fiberpose obtains local fiber diameters. The methodology uses the fact that the value of the DT field at the ridge equals half the fiber thickness at that point. Therefore, by sampling twice the DT value along fiber centerlines at some spacing, Fiberpose estimates the distribution of local fiber diameters.
Third, local fiber orientation is estimated from DT gradients in the vicinity of centerline points. Since these gradients point across the fiber, the local fiber orientation is taken to be perpendicular to the gradient direction. The resulting orientations are interpolated within segmented fragments and color-coded to produce orientation maps.
blocks.zh:
这一表述支持三个分析步骤(图1 d-f)。 首先,实例分解后处理DT字段和候选脊,以产生贴标签的纤维碎片。
第二,独立步骤中,Fiberpose获得局部纤维直径. 该方法使用一个事实,即脊上的DT场值等于该点纤维厚度的一半. 因此,Fiberpose通过在一定间隔处沿着纤维中线取样两次DT值,估计了局部纤维直径的分布情况。
第三,根据中心线点附近的DT梯度来估计局部纤维方向. 由于这些梯度指向横跨纤维,局部的纤维方向被认为与梯度方向是垂直的. 由此产生的方向在片段片段内插入,并用颜色编码来制作方向图.

blocks.en: Fragment-level measurements are aggregated into sample-level descriptors, including fiber-thickness distributions and orientation histograms (Fig. 1 g). This unified pipeline is implemented as an interactive analysis environment (Fig. 1 h) that links neural inference, geometric post-processing, visualization and quantitative export in a desktop application.

blocks.en: DT representation of fibers
blocks.zh: DT 纤维的表示

blocks.en: A predicted DT field, unlike a binary mask or boundary map, encodes fiber geometry in a form that can be read out directly. For an ideal straight fiber of constant width, the DT cross-section is triangular, with a peak at the medial axis of the fiber. Its gradient has a unit magnitude everywhere within the fiber except on that axis, where the DT field exhibits a cusp. In practice, the predicted DT closely matches that theoretical shape: whereas the SEM intensity profile across a single fiber shows bright edge peaks separated by a noisy interior, the predicted profile is approximately triangular (Fig. 2 a–d). Across densely packed fibers, the predicted field resolves distinct ridges with triangular cross-sections for individual objects, even where boundaries are difficult to distinguish by eye in the raw image. This allows touching fibers to be separated at later stages of the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 一个预测的DT字段,与二进制面具或边界图不同,将纤维几何编码成可以直接读出的形式. 对于一个具有恒定宽度的理想直纤维,DT截面呈三角形,在纤维的中间轴处有一个峰值. 它的梯度在纤维内部的任何地方都有一个单位级,除了在那个轴上,DT字段显示一个凸起. 在实践中,预测的DT与这个理论形状很吻合:而单纤维的SEM强度剖面显示由吵闹的内饰分隔的明亮边缘峰,而预测的剖面大约是三角形(图2 a-d). 纵观包裹稠密的纤维,预测的球场会用三角横截面为单个物体解析独特的脊,即使在原始图像中难以用眼睛分辨边界的地方. 这使得触摸的纤维可以在管道的后期分离.

blocks.en: Viewed as a surface in three dimensions, the DT of each fiber forms an approximately triangular prism whose ridge follows the fiber axis (Fig. 2 e). Each analysis step reads a different property of this shape: ridge heights give local radii along measurement centerlines (Fig. 2 f); candidate ridges together with the surrounding field delimit individual instances (Fig. 2 g; Fig. 3 ); and gradients on the ridge flanks give the local normal and hence fiber orientation (Fig. 2 h). A single predicted field thus supports both instance reconstruction and direct quantitative measurement. Because the DT depends only on fiber geometry and not on imaging contrast, the downstream analysis is independent of image modality. The limiting factor is the quality of DT prediction, which depends on the modalities represented in the training data.
blocks.zh: 从三个维度来看,每个纤维的DT形成一个约三角棱镜,其脊沿纤维轴(图2e). 每个分析步骤都读出这种形状的不同属性:山脊高度沿测量中心线(图2f)给予局部光度;候选山脊连同周围的场划定各个实例(图2g;图3);山脊侧翼的梯度给予局部正常的,从而给予纤维方向(图2h)。 因此,一个单一的预测领域既支持实例重建和直接量化衡量。 由于DT只依赖于纤维几何而非成像对比,下游分析独立于图像模式. 限制因素是DT预测的质量,这取决于培训数据中反映的模式。

blocks.en: Tracing ridges and centerlines
blocks.zh: 追踪山脊和中线

blocks.en: Because fiber centerlines are ridges of the DT field (Fig. 2 e), they can be traced with Steger’s ridge detector [ 23 ] . The resulting candidate ridges include both fiber centerlines and V-shaped artifacts near fiber ends.
blocks.zh: 由于纤维中线是DT场的脊(图2 e),因此可以用Steger的脊线探测器进行追踪[23]. 由此产生的候选脊包括纤维中心线和纤维末端附近的V形文物.

blocks.en: Candidate ridges are then grouped into FiberFragments . Each ridge point is expanded into a disk with half its estimated local radius, and ridges whose disks overlap are assigned to the same fragment. This links connected structures, including fiber crossings and overlaps, while keeping distinct instances separate. Each fragment receives an identifier shared by its centerlines, measurements and segmented region, so that a FiberFragment links the sampled diameters and orientations to their spatial locations and to the instance geometry for subsequent analysis.
blocks.zh: 候选人的脊柱被组合成纤维碎片 每个脊点被扩展成一个磁盘,其估计局部半径为一半,其磁盘重叠的脊被分配到同一个片段. 这种连接连接结构,包括纤维交叉和重叠,同时将不同的情况分开。 每个片段都得到其中心线、测量和分块区域共享的标识符,这样,一个纤维碎片就可以将所取样的直径和方向与其空间位置和实例几何连接起来,供随后分析。

blocks.en: Not every ridge point is suitable for measurement: fiber ends, crossings and uncertain regions distort the DT and are excluded from quantitative analysis. Measurement centerlines are therefore selected by geometric rules that test how closely the local DT matches that of an ideal fiber. By default, the local radius must vary little and change only gradually along the ridge. In the optional strict mode, the DT gradients on opposite sides of the centerline must also be antiparallel, and the DT must decrease away from the ridge with unit slope. Segments that pass these rules form the measurement centerlines; the remaining candidate ridges are still used for instance segmentation.
blocks.zh: 并不是每个山脊点都适合测量:纤维末端、交叉点和不确定区域扭曲了DT,被排除在定量分析之外。 因此,测量中心线是通过几何规则选择的,这些规则检验当地DT与理想纤维的匹配程度。 默认情况下,局部半径必须变化不大,只沿山脊逐渐变化. 在可选的严格模式中,中心线两侧的DT梯度也必须是反平行的,DT必须从脊向外减,并带有单位坡度. 通过这些规则的片段构成测量中心线;其余的候选山脊仍然使用,例如分割。

blocks.en: Fiber instance segmentation
blocks.zh: 纤维实例分割

blocks.en: Fiber instances are built from the DT field and the candidate ridges using two alternative methods (Fig. 3 ). In marker-controlled watershed segmentation [ 24 ] , the DT is inverted so that ridges become basins, and each fragment’s ridges serve as markers from which flooding proceeds until neighboring regions meet or the fiber edge is reached (Fig. 3 c,d). Flooding is restricted to pixels with DT slope above desired minima. Ridge expansion segmentation instead takes the union of disks of local radius centered on each fragment’s ridge points; it is simpler but produces slightly rounded instance boundaries (Fig. 3 e,f). In both methods, instances are optionally cleaned up by removing very small, the lowest 1% by centerline length, fragments and fragments with low predicted foreground probability.

blocks.en: Diameter measurements
blocks.zh: 直径测量

blocks.en: Diameters are measured directly from the values of the predicted DT field along the measurement centerlines. FPUNet was trained with Eikonal regularization, which encourages a geometrically correct DT field everywhere except near ridges, where the DT is not differentiable. The predicted maxima are therefore left unconstrained and are usually slightly rounded (Fig. 6 b), so the DT value on the centerline, the apex estimate , underestimates the fiber radius. To reduce this effect, we developed a two-offset sampling procedure that takes DT values at a fixed offset on opposite sides of the centerline. For a centerline point 𝐱 \mathbf{x} with unit normal 𝐧 \mathbf{n} , the corrected estimate of the radius is

blocks.en: Fiber orientation is estimated from the DT gradient. The latter is perpendicular to the local fiber orientation, so it should be rotated by ± 90 ∘ \pm 90^{\circ} to obtain the fiber direction during sampling. Angles follow the convention and color coding of OrientationJ [ 25 ] : they range from − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} to + 90 ∘ +90^{\circ} , measured relative to the horizontal axis, and are encoded with a cyclic color wheel (Fig. 4 a). Because the gradient direction is undefined on the ridge itself, Fiberpose samples gradients in the vicinity of each measurement centerline point rather than directly on it.

The orientation distribution can also be visualized directly by computing the gradient direction from the spatial derivatives ∂ D / ∂ x \partial D/\partial x and ∂ D / ∂ y \partial D/\partial y at every pixel (Fig. 4 b,c). Such direct gradient maps, however, show artifacts near ridges, where opposing gradients meet, as well as near fiber ends and in short fragments with undefined centerlines (Fig. 4 c, inset). Fiberpose therefore interpolates the centerline orientations throughout each segmented fragment using inverse-distance weighting, producing coloring that spans the entire instance area and is free of these artifacts (Fig. 4 d, inset).

blocks.en: The software
blocks.zh: 软件

blocks.en: Fiberpose is implemented as a desktop application written in Python, with a graphical user interface (GUI) for interactive analysis and a command-line mode for batch processing of image folders and stacks (Fig. 5 ). A web version is available at https://fiberpose.org . The GUI displays every intermediate product of the pipeline, including the predicted DT field, candidate ridges, measurement centerlines, segmented instances, sampling sites and orientation maps. This allows users to inspect each step and judge how far the resulting measurements can be trusted. Results can be exported as images and as tables at both the per-image and per-sample level.
blocks.zh: Fiberpose作为写在Python的桌面应用程序执行,具有用于交互分析的图形用户界面(GUI)和用于批量处理图像文件夹和堆栈(图5)的命令行模式. 网页版本见https://fiberpose.org。 图形用户界面显示管道的每一个中间产品,包括预测的DT场,候选山脊,测量中心线,片段实例,取样地点和方向图. 这使得用户可以检查每个步骤,判断由此得出的测量结果可以信任的程度. 结果可以导出为图像,也可以导出为每个图像和每个样本的表格。

blocks.en: We compared the apex and corrected estimates at identical, manually defined locations. Manual diameters (ten per image) were measured in ImageJ on ten SEM images not used for training.

blocks.en: The apex estimate systematically underestimated fiber diameter, with a mean bias of − 1.47 -1.47 px and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.53 px across the ten images (Fig. 6 c). The corrected estimate reduced the bias to − 0.84 -0.84 px and the MAE to 1.07 px, a 29.9% reduction, over the full range of measured diameters (9–40 px). The MAE was lower in nine of the ten images (one-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, n = 10 n=10 images, p = 0.002 p=0.002 ).

blocks.zh: 长纤维的分化

blocks.en:
We benchmark Fiberpose for instance segmentation on a set of ten SEM images, including five with randomly oriented fibers and five with aligned fibers, and compare it with uncurated SAM2 (automatic masks without filtering; see Methods
) [ 31 , 32 ] and Cellpose-SAM [ 19 ] . We evaluate two variants of Fiberpose , using watershed and ridge-expansion post-processing. To focus on elongated structures, the evaluation is restricted to ground-truth instances with circularity ≤ 0.5 \leq 0.5 , corresponding approximately to an equivalent aspect ratio ≥ 4 \geq 4 under a rectangular approximation (see Methods).
blocks.zh:
例如,我们以10个SEM图像(包括5个随机定向纤维和5个对齐纤维)作为基准,并将其与未加工的SAM2(自动口罩不过滤;见方法)进行比较。
[31,32]和Cellpose-SAM [19]. 我们利用流域和山脊扩展处理后的两种变体Fiberpose。 为了将重点放在较长的结构上,评价只限于在长方形近似(见方法)下,以零下0.5\leq 0.5的圆形地面真实情况,大致相当于相等的宽度比。

blocks.en: Segmentation performance is evaluated using instance recall and precision, together with matched-pair intersection over union (IoU), normalized surface Dice (NSD), and the 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) [ 33 ] . The image-level metric values are subsequently averaged over the test set. Table 1 reports the mean and sample standard deviation across the ten test images.
blocks.zh: 利用实例召回和精确度来评估分块性能,以及配对-pair交叉点(IoU),普通的表层凹槽(NSD)和95百分位的Husdorff距离(HD95)[33]. 图像水平的度量值随后在测试集中平均。 表1报告10个测试图像的平均和抽样标准差。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Comparison of instance segmentation performance. Values are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation. Only ground-truth instances with circularity ≤ 0.5 \leq 0.5 (equivalent aspect ratio ≥ 4 \geq 4 ) were evaluated; recall and precision are defined in Methods. Best mean values are highlighted in bold.
blocks.zh: 表1:实例分割性能比较。 数值报告为平均值±\pm标准差. 仅评价了零下0.5\leq 0.5(相当于宽比 4\geq 4)的地面真实情况;方法中界定了召回和精确性。 以黑体突出显示最佳平均值。

blocks.en: Fiberpose detected elongated fibers both more completely than Cellpose-SAM and more specifically than SAM2 (Table 1 ). The two baselines failed in complementary ways. Cellpose-SAM rarely produced false instances but missed a substantial fraction of elongated fibers, so its precision remained high while its recall dropped to 0.70 0.70 (for equivalent aspect ratio ≥ 4 \geq 4 ). Uncurated SAM2 demonstrated the opposite behaviour: it recovered most fibers, but only alongside a large number of nonspecific object predictions, which reduced its precision to 0.10 0.10 . Fiberpose combined the strengths of both, reaching the highest recall and the highest precision among the evaluated methods in either post-processing mode. Its recall was significantly higher than that of Cellpose-SAM and its precision significantly higher than that of SAM2 (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, n = 10 n=10 images, p = 0.002 p=0.002 for both comparisons and both post-processing modes), while it did not differ significantly from each baseline on that baseline’s stronger metric.
blocks.zh: 纤维比Cellpose-SAM更完整,更具体地说,比SAM2(表1)更能检测到长纤维。 这两个基线是相辅相成的。 Cellpose-SAM很少产生假例,但漏掉了相当一部分延长的纤维,因此其精度仍然很高,而召回率则下降到0.70 0.70(对等的宽度比为QQ 4\geq 4 ). 未校准的SAM2表现出相反的行为:它回收了大部分纤维,但仅与大量的非特定物体预测同时进行,使其精度降低到0.100.10. Fiberpose结合了两者的长处,在后处理模式中,在被评价方法中达到最高召回和最高精确度. 它的召回率明显高于Cellpose-SAM,其精度也明显高于SAM2(Paired Wilcoxon sign-rank test,n = 10 n = 10 图像,p = 0.002 p = 0.002用于比较和后处理模式),而根据该基准较强的度量度,它与每个基准没有显著的差异.

blocks.en: This gain in detection did not come at the cost of mask quality. For instances matched to ground truth, IoU, NSD and HD95 of watershed Fiberpose did not differ significantly from those of Cellpose-SAM or SAM2, and no method was best on all three metrics (Table 1 ). HD95 also varied substantially across images, which limits interpretability of small differences in its mean. These matched-pair scores must be read together with the detection metrics, because they describe only successfully matched instances and ignore missed or unmatched predictions [ 34 ] . This distinction is particularly important for uncurated SAM2, which achieves high matched-pair IoU despite very low precision, reflecting a large number of nonspecific predictions.
blocks.zh: 探测的这一收益并非以面具质量为代价。 对于与地面真理相符的情况,IoU、NSD和HD95的分水岭纤维与Cellpose-SAM或SAM2没有显著区别,在所有三个度量标准上没有任何方法是最好的(表1)。 HD95在图像之间也有很大差异,这限制了小差异的可解释性。 这些匹配-pair的分数必须与检测度量衡一起读取,因为它们只描述成功匹配的例,忽略了错失或无匹配的预测[34]. 这种区别对于未精度的SAM2特别重要,它尽管精度非常低,却实现了高配对的IoU,反映了大量的非具体预测.

blocks.en: The choice of post-processing within Fiberpose affected boundaries rather than detection. Recall and precision did not differ significantly between the two variants, whereas watershed yielded higher IoU and NSD and lower HD95 than ridge expansion (Table 1 ). Thus, for elongated fibers, Fiberpose detected instances more completely than Cellpose-SAM and more specifically than SAM2, with comparable mask quality.
blocks.zh: 在Fiberpose内部选择后处理会影响边界,而不是检测。 两种变体的回溯和精确性没有显著差异,而流域产生的IoU和NSD值较高,HD95比脊扩张值低(表1)。 因此,对于线长的纤维,比起Cellpose-SAM,更具体地说,比起具有类似面具质量的SAM2,Fiberpose检测到的情况更完整.

blocks.en: The differences in segmentation performance may be partly explained by the underlying field representations (Fig. 7 ). Cellpose-SAM predicts a center-directed flow field (Fig. 7 a), which becomes increasingly ambiguous for elongated structures with extended central regions, complicating flow integration and instance reconstruction (Fig. 7 c). In contrast, Fiberpose predicts a distance field (Fig. 7 b), encoding local distances to fiber boundaries. This representation enables the detection of elongated centerlines through ridge detection and subsequent reconstruction of individual fiber instances (Fig. 7 d). The difference is further illustrated by instance recall as a function of equivalent aspect ratio (Fig. 7 f). While Cellpose-SAM recall decreases substantially as progressively more elongated instances are considered, Fiberpose maintains consistently high recall, with SAM2 showing intermediate performance.
blocks.zh: 划分业绩的差异部分可归因于基本的外地代表(图7)。 Cellpose-SAM预测一个中心方向的流场(图7 a),对于具有延伸的中央区域的较长结构,流场整合和实例重建变得日益模糊不清(图7 c). 相比之下,Fiberpose预测了一个距离域(图7b),将局部距离编码为纤维边界. 这种表述能够通过山脊检测和随后的单个纤维例重建来检测延长的中线(图7d)。 以实例来进一步说明这一差别,即是视其相对比(图7f)。 虽然Cellpose-SAM的召回量因考虑逐渐延长的情况而大为减少,但Fiberpose的召回量一直很高,SAM2显示中间性能。

blocks.en: In rare cases, Fiberpose remains susceptible to segmentation errors arising from inaccuracies in the predicted distance field. In particular, artificial connections between adjacent fibers may cause several fibers to merge into a single instance (Fig. 7 d). However, that instance segmentation and fiber diameter estimation are performed through separate operations on the predicted distance field. Diameters are estimated by sampling local radii along detected centerlines rather than from reconstructed instance boundaries (Fig. 7 e). Consequently, diameters remain measurable even where adjacent fibers merge into a single instance.
blocks.zh: 在极少数情况下,Fiberpose仍然容易因预测距离域的不准确性而产生分块错误. 特别是,相邻纤维之间的人工连接可能导致若干纤维合并成单一实例(图7d). 然而,这种实例的分割和纤维直径估计是通过在预测的距离场上进行单独的操作进行的。 数字计是通过按检测到的中心线取样而不是从重建实例边界(图7e)来估计的。 因此,即使相邻的纤维合并为单一实例,直径仍然可以衡量。

blocks.en: Diameter accuracy against manual reference
blocks.zh: 对照人工参考的精确度

blocks.en: The diameter benchmark included 20 SEM images not used for training, covering both high-contrast images with clearly defined fibers and challenging images with faint borders, non-uniform fiber contrast and variable sizes. Diameters obtained with Fiberpose in default and strict modes, DiameterJ [ 7 ] , Fibar [ 35 ] and GIFT [ 9 ] were compared with manual measurements, using the relative absolute error per image (%) as the metric and the paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test for pairwise comparisons ( n = 20 n=20 images; n = 18 n=18 for GIFT ).
blocks.zh: 直径基准包括20个没有用于训练的SEM图像,既包括高孔图像,并有明确界定的纤维,也包括具有微弱边界、非统一纤维对比和可变大小的挑战性图像。 用Fiberpose在默认和严格模式下获得的直径,DiameterJ [7],Fibar [35]和GIFT [9]与人工测量进行了比较,使用每个图像的相对绝对误差(%)作为度量,并用对齐的Wilcoxon签名排名测试进行对偶比较(n=20n=20图像;n=18n=18 GIFT).

blocks.en: Fiberpose measured fiber diameters significantly more accurately than all three existing tools. The median relative absolute error was 4.2% in default mode and 4.1% in strict mode, compared with 13.7% for DiameterJ , 17.7% for Fibar and 82.2% for GIFT (Fig. 8 e), and every tool differed significantly from both Fiberpose modes ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 for all comparisons). Fiberpose errors also varied least between images and never exceeded 20%, over the whole range of fiber diameters (Fig. 8 f). Fiberpose showed a small systematic underestimation, with a median signed error of − 1.20 -1.20 px in default mode and − 0.70 -0.70 px in strict mode.
blocks.zh: 纤维直径比所有三种现有工具都精确得多。 相对绝对误差的中位数在默认模式中为4.2%,严格模式中为4.1%,相比之下,DiameterJ为13.7%,Fibar为17.7%,GIFT为82.2%(图8e),每个工具都与Fiberpose模式有很大不同(所有比较的p < 0.01 p < 0.01)。 纤维误差在图像中差异最小,在纤维直径的整个范围上从未超过20%(图8 f). Fiberpose显示了一个小的系统低估,在默认模式下,中位数签名错误为−1.20 -1.20 px,严格模式下为−0.70 -0.70 px.

blocks.en: The lower accuracy of DiameterJ and Fibar did not result from a systematic error. Their median signed errors were close to zero ( − 0.20 -0.20 px and + 1.10 +1.10 px, respectively); instead, both tools were accurate on some images and produced large errors on others, which is reflected in their wide error spread (Fig. 8 e,f). These errors can be explained by the quality of the semantic segmentation on which both tools rely: merging of adjacent fibers increased the estimated diameter, whereas incomplete segmentation of a fiber decreased it. The SRM segmentation of DiameterJ is susceptible to both errors, and the skeleton derived from it is rough: although DiameterJ attempts to filter out fiber junctions, its skeleton remains less precise than the measurement centerlines of Fiberpose (Fig. 8 a,b). Fibar does not provide intermediate segmentation results; a mask reimplemented following its published pipeline contained more incompletely segmented fibers than the DiameterJ mask, and the only output of the tool contained many misaligned measurement marks (Fig. 8 c). Consequently, both tools provide reliable results only on carefully selected images.
blocks.zh: DiameterJ和Fibar的精度较低并不是系统性错误造成的. 他们的中位签名错误接近于零(分别为−0.20-0.20 px和+1.10 +1.10 px);相反,这两个工具在一些图像上准确,在另一些图像上产生大错误,这反映在其大错误分布上(图8 e,f). 这些错误可以用两种工具所依赖的语义分解的质量来解释:相邻纤维的合并提高了估计直径,而纤维的不完全分解则降低了直径. DiameterJ的SRM分解容易出现两种错误,由此衍生的骨架很粗糙:虽然Diameter J试图过滤出纤维交叉口,其骨架仍然不如Fiberpose的测量中心线(图8 a,b)精确. Fibar不提供中间分解结果;在其公布的管道后重新执行的面具含有比DiameterJ面具更不完整的分解纤维,工具的唯一输出包含许多错配的测量标记(图8 c). 因此,这两个工具只在仔细选定的图像上提供可靠的结果。

blocks.en: GIFT was the most fragile method: it performed acceptably on some images but failed on most of them, and returned no valid estimate for two of the 20 images. Its edge-detection result and the lines retained after filtering at 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} show that the underlying signal can be weak and unstable (Fig. 8 d). In contrast, Fiberpose measures diameters directly on the predicted DT field, and its performance was robust to image appearance (Fig. 8 a). Thus, Fiberpose was the only method whose diameter error remained low and consistent across the whole benchmark.
blocks.zh: GIFT是最为脆弱的方法:它在某些图像上表现得令人接受,但在大多数图像上却失败了,并且没有返回20幅图像中2幅的有效估计. 它的边缘探测结果和过滤后在0∘0^{\0^{\circ}时保留的线条显示,基础信号可能很弱和不稳定(图8 d). 相比之下,Fiberpose直接在预测的DT场上测量直径,其性能坚固到图像外观(图8 a). 因此,Fiberpose是唯一一个直径误差仍然很低且在整个基准内一致的方法。

blocks.en: Orientation agreement with established tools
blocks.zh: 与既定工具的定向协议

blocks.en: As no manual ground truth is available for fiber orientation, Fiberpose was evaluated by its agreement with two widely used tools, OrientationJ [ 25 ] and Directionality [ 37 ] . Qualitatively, Fiberpose and OrientationJ produced orientation maps with consistent predominant directions (Fig. 9 a–d; color wheel in Fig. 4 a). However, OrientationJ coloring was blurred and for thick fibers concentrated along their borders, where intensity gradients are strongest, leaving fiber interiors empty (Fig. 9 c). Fiberpose maps were uniformly filled across the full fiber width and sharply bounded by the segmented instances, independently of fiber thickness (Fig. 9 b,d).
blocks.zh: 由于没有手动进行纤维定向的地面真伪,因此Fiberpose通过使用两个广泛使用的工具 -- -- 定向J[25]和定向[37] -- -- 的协议得到了评估。 定性、纤维和方向 J绘制了具有一致主要方向的定向图(图9 a-d;图4 a中的色轮)。 然而,方向 J色线模糊不清,对于浓密的纤维则集中在其边界沿线,那里的强度梯度最强,使纤维内部空置(图9 c). 纤维图在全纤维宽度范围内均匀填充,并用分层实例作尖锐的限定,与纤维厚度无关(图9b,d)。

blocks.en:
Quantitatively, Fiberpose agreed with the established tools as closely as they agreed with each other. Across all images ( n = 20 n=20 ), the absolute difference in orientation index was similar for all three method pairs, with no statistically significant difference (median | Δ ​ OI | = 0.068 |\Delta\mathrm{OI}|=0.068 , 0.078 0.078 and 0.067 0.067 for Fiberpose–OrientationJ, Fiberpose–Directionality and OrientationJ–Directionality, respectively; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p ≥ 0.87 p\geq 0.87 ).
Circular Wasserstein distances between the angular distributions were also likewise comparable (median 4.8 ∘ 4.8^{\circ} , 4.5 ∘ 4.5^{\circ} and 5.1 ∘ 5.1^{\circ} ; p ≥ 0.13 p\geq 0.13 ; Fig. 9 e,f). Overall, Fiberpose reproduced the orientation statistics of established tools while additionally providing instance-resolved maps that cover the full fiber width.
blocks.zh:
从数量上看,Fiberpose同意了既定的工具,就像它们彼此同意一样。 在所有图像(n = 20 n = 20)中,所有三种方法对的定向指数的绝对差异是相似的,没有统计上显著的差异(中位数 = | OI = 0.068 = el Delta\mathrm{OI}|= 0.068,Fiberpose–OrientationJ,Fiberpose–Directionality和FirectionJ–Directional;配对的Wilcoxon签名恶作剧测试,p≥ 0.87 p\geq 0.87).
角分布之间的圆环瓦瑟斯坦距离同样可以比较(中间点4.8 ∘ 4.8 ^{\circ}、4.5 ∘ 4.5 ^{\crc}和5.1 ∘ 5.1 ^{\crc};p 0.13 p\geq 0.13;图9 e,f)。 总体而言,Fiberpose复制了既有工具的定向统计,同时提供了覆盖全纤维宽度的实例解析地图。

blocks.en: Qualitative generalization beyond the training domain
blocks.zh: 培训领域以外的定性概括

blocks.en: Fiberpose detected fibrous structures in every image group tested, including materials and microscopy modalities absent from its training data (Fig. 10 ). The model was trained exclusively on real and synthetic SEM images and was designed to detect bright fibers against a dark background. It was applied here without retraining and with default parameters; the only adaptation was intensity inversion of images acquired using transmission-based modalities, including TEM and conventional transmitted-light microscopy. The examples were taken from openly licensed publications and Wikimedia Commons, and none of the SEM examples belong to the training collection.
blocks.zh: 在所测试的每个图像组中检测到纤维结构,包括培训数据中没有的材料和显微镜模式(图10)。 该模型专门接受真实和合成的SEM图像的培训,设计目的是在黑暗背景中检测亮光纤维. 它在此应用时没有再培训,并且有默认参数;唯一的适应是使用传输方式获取的图像的强度反转,包括TEM和常规的传输光显微镜. 这些例子取自公开许可的出版物和Wikimedia Communications,SEM的例子都不属于培训收藏。

blocks.en: The examples are ordered by increasing distance from the training domain. The SEM examples cover polymer and mineral fibers (an electrospun PCL scaffold, amosite asbestos, a woven polycotton fabric and a swimwear fabric) and biological samples (a cell spread over electrospun fibers, wood-pulp paper and porcine collagen fibrils). The TEM examples show collagen fibrils in uterine tissue and in a human skin equivalent, isolated banded collagen fibrils, and myofilaments of Drosophila flight muscle. The optical microscopy examples show dandelion pappus fibers, eucalyptus kraft-pulp fibers, an archaeological animal-hair fiber and aspen wood fiber cells. Detections were obtained across all groups despite substantial differences in image contrast, background texture, fiber appearance and scale, from collagen fibrils and myofilaments to textile yarns and wood fibers. Visual inspection indicated a higher frequency of false-positive or incomplete detections in the TEM and optical images, which are not represented in the training set; typical errors were spurious detections in textured background and fragmented outlines of weakly contrasted fibers.
blocks.zh: 实例是通过增加培训领域的距离来排序的。 SEM的例子包括聚合物和矿物纤维(电子喷嘴PCL脚手架、烟石棉、织物多科顿织物和游泳服织物)和生物样品(一个细胞分布在电子喷嘴纤维、木质脉冲纸和猪笼草纤维上)。 TEM的例子显示,子宫组织中和人类皮肤等同物中存在锥虫纤维、孤立的带状锥虫纤维和Drosophila飞行肌肉的肌梗。 光学显微镜实例显示:dandelion pappus纤维、 eucalyptus kraft-pulp纤维、一种古老的动物毛发纤维和Aspen木质纤维细胞。 尽管在图像对比、背景纹理、纤维外观和尺度上存在着很大差异,从锥虫纤维和肌纤维到纺织纱和木纤维,所有群体都得到了检测。 视觉检查显示,在TEM和光学图像中,假阳性或不完整的检测频率较高,这些检测没有在培训集中得到体现;典型的错误是纹理背景中的假检测和微弱对比纤维的断裂轮廓。

blocks.en: Thus, although trained only on real and synthetic SEM images, Fiberpose produced qualitatively meaningful detections across polymer, mineral, plant and animal fibers imaged by electron and optical microscopy. As a next step, we will extend the training dataset to these imaging domains to further improve generalization.
blocks.zh: 因此,Fiberpose虽然只接受关于真实和合成的SEM图像的培训,但通过电子和光学显微镜对聚合物、矿物、植物和动物纤维进行了质量上有意义的检测。 作为下一步,我们将把培训数据集扩大到这些成像领域,以进一步提高通用性。

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: Fiberpose shows that fiber morphometry does not have to pass through a binary mask. By predicting the DT field directly from the image and measuring on that field, it reached a median diameter error of about 4%, compared with 14–82% for DiameterJ , Fibar and GIFT , and detected elongated fibers more completely than Cellpose-SAM and more specifically than SAM2. We attribute this to combining the strengths of two lines of work in a single predicted field: the learned geometric field prediction of Cellpose and Omnipose [ 17 , 18 ] and the DT-based measurement of DiameterJ [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: Fiberpose显示纤维发作不需要通过二进制口罩. 通过直接从图像中预测DT场并在该场上测量,它达到了约4%的中位直径误差,而DiameterJ,Fibar和GIFT的中位直径误差为14-82%,并且比Cellpose-SAM更完整地检测到长纤维,更具体地说比SAM2. 我们将此归因于将单一预测领域的两条工作线的优势结合起来:对Cellpose和Ommipose的几何场预测[17,18]和基于DT的测量DimetJ [7].

blocks.en: Three developments were needed to make this approach work. The first is an annotated dataset of fiber SEM images, complemented by synthetic images, which we created for this work. The second is a training procedure that yields a geometrically correct DT field, combining gradient supervision with static and dynamic Eikonal regularization. The third is a pipeline that extracts quantitative data from such predictions: geometric selection of measurement centerlines excludes fiber ends and crossings, where the field is distorted, and two-offset sampling corrects for the rounding of the predicted ridges.
blocks.zh: 要使这种办法发挥作用,需要三个方面。 第一个是带注释的光纤SEM图像数据集,辅以合成图像,我们为这项工作创造了这种数据集。 第二种是产生几何正确DT字段的培训程序,将梯度监督与静态和动态的Eikonal正规化相结合。 第三是从这种预测中提取定量数据的管道:测量中心线的几何选择排除了纤维端和交叉,其中的场面被扭曲,对预测的脊的四舍五入进行双反的取样纠正.

blocks.en: The main consequence of working on the predicted field is that measurement no longer depends on instance segmentation. In our benchmark, the errors of DiameterJ and Fibar could be traced to their masks, in which merged fibers increased the estimated diameter and incompletely segmented fibers decreased it. Fiberpose diameters, read along the measurement centerlines of the DT field, remained measurable even where adjacent fibers merged into a single instance (Fig. 7 e).
blocks.zh: 在预测领域工作的主要后果是,衡量不再取决于实例的分割。 在我们的基准中,DiameterJ和Fibar的错误可以追溯到他们的面具上,其中合并的纤维增加了估计直径,不完整的分化纤维减少了. 沿DT场的测量中心线读取的纤维直径仍然可以测量,即使相邻的纤维合并为一个实例(图7e)。

blocks.en: The accuracy of Fiberpose diameters stayed consistent across images on which the existing tools ranged from accurate to failing. Orientation results agreed with OrientationJ and Directionality as closely as these two established tools agreed with each other, while Fiberpose additionally provided orientation maps within segmented instances. In terms of mask quality, Fiberpose reached matched-instance IoU comparable to Cellpose-SAM, with no statistically significant difference between the two methods. Thus, Fiberpose combines mask quality on par with a foundation-model-based segmenter with reliable fiber detection and accurate morphometry.
blocks.zh: 纤维直径的准确性与现有工具从准确到失败不等的图像一致。 定向结果与定向J和定向一致,就像这两个既定工具相互一致一致一样,而Fiberpose则在片段内提供了定向图。 在面具质量方面,Fiberpose达到了与Cellpose-SAM相当的匹配IoU,在统计学上两种方法没有显著区别. 因此,Fiberpose将面罩质量与基于基础模型的分线器等同结合,并有可靠的纤维检测和准确的摩度测量.

blocks.en:
This was achieved with a compact network. The
pretrained FPUNet contains 0.93M parameters (3.7 MB in FP32),
about 7-fold fewer than the models used in the original Cellpose and
Omnipose frameworks ( ∼ \sim 6.6M) and about 330-fold fewer than the
transformer-based Cellpose-SAM ( ∼ \sim 305M).
Even with the quality-control branch, the complete FPWNet remains
compact (1.35M parameters, 5.4 MB). One possible explanation is the relatively constrained geometry of fibrous structures. Unlike cells, which exhibit considerable diversity in shape and internal organization, fibers share characteristic geometric properties, including elongation, locally parallel boundaries, and gradual variations in radius along their length. These properties are largely independent of material composition and imaging modality, potentially reducing the complexity of the features required to infer geometric distance from image intensity. Consequently, a compact convolutional network may be sufficient to learn this mapping without requiring a large number of feature channels. Larger architectures, particularly transformer-based models [ 52 , 53 ] , may offer advantages in representational capacity and cross-domain generalization, but these potential benefits must be balanced against increased computational requirements. Systematic benchmarking on larger and more diverse datasets, including measurements of inference time, memory consumption, and accuracy, is needed to determine whether additional model complexity provides a meaningful advantage for DT prediction.

blocks.en: Although the present framework was developed primarily for SEM images, qualitative experiments demonstrated its ability to detect fibrous structures in other imaging domains, including transmission electron and optical microscopy of biological materials. These observations suggest that the model has learned geometric invariants of fibrous structures that generalize across differences in image appearance. However, the model was trained exclusively on real and synthetic SEM images, and reduced detection specificity was observed in previously unseen imaging domains. Broader quantitative validation and training on multimodal datasets will therefore be necessary to establish reliable performance on natural fibers, collagen networks [ 54 , 55 ] , cytoskeletal structures [ 56 ] , and other biological specimens.
blocks.zh: 虽然本框架主要是为SEM图像开发的,但质量实验表明它有能力在其他成像领域探测纤维结构,包括传播电子和生物材料的光学显微镜。 这些观察表明,模型已经学会了纤维结构的几何变化论,这些变化论概括了图像外观上的差异. 然而,该模型只接受了关于真实和合成的SEM图像的培训,在先前未见的成像领域观察到检测特性降低。 因此,有必要就多式联运数据集进行更广泛的定量验证和培训,以确立自然纤维、碳化物网络[54、55]、细胞骨骼结构[56]和其他生物标本的可靠性能。

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. Very thin fibers, particularly those only a few pixels wide, are challenging to represent accurately with a smooth distance-transform field because of the limited spatial information available for reliable ridge extraction and gradient estimation. Upscaling may improve numerical stability, although interpolation cannot recover geometric information absent from the original image. Another limitation is that Fiberpose identifies individual fiber fragments rather than reconstructing complete fiber networks. Recovering network connectivity would require additional methods, potentially incorporating graph-based approaches [ 57 , 58 ] to link fragments and resolve intersections. Finally, the present work focuses on two-dimensional images, although the underlying methodology could be extended to volumetric data through the prediction of three-dimensional distance fields and extraction of spatial centerlines.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 极薄的纤维,特别是只有少数像素宽的纤维,由于可用于可靠山脊提取和梯度估计的空间信息有限,很难用光滑的远距离变形场来准确表示。 缩放可能会提高数值稳定性,尽管插值无法恢复原始图像中没有的几何信息. 另一种限制是,Fiberpose识别单个纤维碎片,而不是重建完整的纤维网络. 恢复网络连通性需要更多的方法,可能采用基于图表的方法[57、58]来连接碎片和解决交叉。 最后,目前的工作侧重于二维图像,虽然可以通过预测三维距离场和提取空间中心线将基础方法扩展到量子数据.

blocks.en: In summary, predicting the DT field instead of a binary mask turns a single network output into instance segmentation, diameter and orientation measurements, and on the evaluated SEM images it outperformed existing tools in diameter accuracy and fiber detection. Fiberpose is provided as a desktop application and a web tool that displays every intermediate image object, from the DT field to measurement centerlines, so that each measurement can be inspected and reproduced [ 59 ] . With further validation across materials, imaging modalities and laboratories, this common geometric representation could replace the collection of task-specific image-processing procedures currently used for fiber morphometry and support standardized quantitative analysis of fibrous structures.
blocks.zh: 简言之,预测DT场而不是二进制遮罩将单一的网络输出转化为实例分割,直径和方向测量,在被评价的SEM图像上,它在直径精度和纤维检测上的表现超过了现有工具. Fiberpose作为桌面应用程序和显示每个中间图像对象的网络工具提供,从DT字段到测量中心线,这样可以检查和复制每个测量[59]. 通过跨材料、成像模式和实验室的进一步验证,这种通用的几何表示法可以取代目前用于纤维度量测定的任务特定图像处理程序的收集,并支持纤维结构的标准化定量分析。

blocks.en:
We use a FPUNet network based on [ 60 ] , which is a compact residual U-Net encoder–decoder with a configurable number of resolution levels. Each level contains a residual block consisting of two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions with group normalization [ 61 ] , ReLU activation, and a shortcut connection. Downsampling is performed using strided convolutions, while the decoder uses bilinear interpolation and skip connections from corresponding encoder levels. A final 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution produces the output.
The FPUNet comprises five resolution levels with feature widths of 16, 24, 48, 96, and 144 channels and maps a grayscale input image I ⁡ ( x , y ) I(x,y) to a single-channel distance-transform field D ​ T ​ ( x , y ) DT(x,y) without an output activation function.

我们使用一个基于[60]的FPUNet网络,这是一个紧凑的剩余U-Net编码器–解码器,具有可配置的分辨率级. 每个关卡都包含一个剩余块,由两个3×3 3\时的3个与组态正常化的集合[61],ReLU激活,以及快捷连接组成. Downsampling是使用strided convolution进行的,而解码器则使用双线插值,并跳过来自相应编码器水平的连接. 最终的1×1 1\times 1 演化产生输出.
FPUNet包含5个分辨率级,特征宽度为16,24,48,96,以及144个通道,并将一个灰色比例的输入图像I QQ(x,y) I(x,y)映射到一个单通道的远程变形场D T(x,y) DT(x,y),没有输出激活功能.

blocks.en: In addition to the main FPUNet network described above, we add an additional second FPUNet that estimates foreground probability from the predicted distance field. It is used to identify fiber regions suitable for reliable analysis. This network uses a smaller configuration with four resolution levels and feature widths of 12, 24, 48, and 96 channels, with sigmoid activation applied to its output. When combined, the two networks form FPWNet [ 62 ] , a cascaded architecture in which the distance-transform prediction serves as input to the foreground network.
blocks.zh: 除了上述的主要FPUNet网络外,我们额外增加了第二个FPUNet,从预测的距离字段估计前景概率. 它被用来确定适于可靠分析的纤维区. 这个网络使用一个较小的配置,有四个分辨率级,特征宽度为12,24,48,以及96个通道,其输出应用了sigmoid激活. 两个网络合并后形成FPWNet[62],是一种阶梯式架构,其中远程变换预测作为对前景网络的投入.

blocks.en: A collection of 275 distinct SEM images of fibrous structures was assembled from published scientific articles distributed under CC BY licences. Of these, 60 images were selected for sparse instance annotation and used as real-image training data. The training set additionally included 50 synthetically generated SEM-like images to increase the diversity of fiber geometries and image appearances.
blocks.zh: 从根据CC BY许可证发行的已发表的科学文章中收集了275幅不同的SEM纤维结构图像。 其中60幅图像被选作稀有的注释,并用作真实图像培训数据。 培训内容还包括50个合成生成的类似SEM的图像,以增加纤维几何和图像外观的多样性。

blocks.en: Sparse instance annotation was used [ 63 ] , distinguishing positive, negative, and ignored regions. Selected fiber fragments were annotated as individual instances, while selected background regions were labeled as negative. All remaining regions were left unlabeled and excluded from direct supervision. Coarse initial masks were generated using Segment Anything 2 [ 32 ] and subsequently refined manually in custom Python script and GIMP image editor.

Input images were converted to grayscale and independently normalized to the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . During each training epoch, a single random 384 × 384 384\times 384 pixel crop was extracted from each image after applying a random rotation.
Additional on-the-fly photometric augmentations were applied including variations in brightness, contrast, gamma, non-uniform illumination, Gaussian noise, and blur. Geometric transformations were applied consistently to the input images and distance-transform (DT) targets, whereas photometric augmentations were applied only to the input images.
blocks.zh:
输入图像被转换成灰度,并独立正常化到范围[0,1] [0,1]. 在每次训练期间,在进行随机旋转后,从每个图像中提取一个单随机384×384\时的384像素作物.
采用了额外的飞行光度增强法,包括亮度、对比度、伽马、非统一照明、高斯噪音和模糊度的变化。 几何转换一直用于输入图像和远距离变换(DT)目标,而光度增强则仅适用于输入图像。

blocks.en: The network was trained using the AdamW optimizer [ 66 ] in two stages. The initial stage consisted of 300 epochs with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and a batch size of 16, using only the Huber loss on predicted DT values. The subsequent refinement stage consisted of 1,700 epochs with a reduced learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and a batch size of 4. During this stage, the loss function combined the Huber loss on DT values, the Huber loss on DT gradients, static and dynamic Eikonal regularization terms, with relative weights of 1, 10, 10, and 1, respectively. Model performance was monitored on a separate validation dataset, and the checkpoint minimizing the dynamic Eikonal loss was selected. Training was implemented in PyTorch [ 67 ] .
blocks.zh: 网络培训采用亚当W优化器[66]分两个阶段进行. 初始阶段由300个纪元组成,学习率为10−3 10^{-3},批量规模为16个,只使用预测的DT值上的Huber损失. 随后的完善阶段包括1,700个纪元,学习率降低为10-5 10^{-5},批量规模为4. 在这一阶段,损失函数结合了DT值的Huber损失,DT梯度的Huber损失,静态和动态的Eikonal正规化术语,相对权重分别为1,10,10和1. 模型性能通过单独的验证数据集进行监控,选择了将动态Eikonal损失最小化的检查站. 在PyTorch进行了培训[67]。

blocks.en: Postprocessing

blocks.en: Candidate ridges were extracted from the distance-transform (DT) field using a Steger-type subpixel ridge detector [ 23 ] . Gaussian derivatives were computed at σ = 1.0 \sigma=1.0 pixel, with lower and upper ridge-response thresholds of 0.15 0.15 and 0.35 0.35 , respectively. Adjacent ridge points with compatible positions and orientations were linked into subpixel ridge polylines.

blocks.en: Local radii r i = D ​ T ​ ( p i ) r_{i}=DT(p_{i}) were sampled from the floating-point DT field at nearest-pixel coordinates. Ridge polylines were grouped into fiber fragments when their rasterized radial expansions of radius 0.5 ​ r i 0.5r_{i} overlapped. Each resulting fragment represents a spatially connected, indivisible portion of a fiber or fiber network in the image.

blocks.en: Measurement centerlines were selected from candidate ridges using four criteria that test how closely the local DT field matches that of an ideal fiber: (i) low variation in local radius, (ii) gradual change in local radius along the ridge, (iii) antiparallel DT gradients on opposite sides of the centerline, and (iv) unit-slope decrease of the DT away from the ridge. Criteria (i) and (ii) were applied by default; criteria (iii) and (iv) were added in the optional strict mode.
blocks.zh: 从候选山脊中选取了测量中心线,采用四个标准,测试当地DT场与理想纤维的匹配程度: (一)局部半径差异小, (二)沿山脊的局部半径逐渐变化, (三)中心线对面的反平行DT梯度, (四)离山脊外的DT的单位斜坡减少. 标准(一)和(二)在默认情况下适用;标准(三)和(四)在任择严格模式中增加。

A window was accepted when the standard deviation of nearest-pixel DT samples was below 0.8 0.8 pixels (criterion i) and the radius-change angle satisfied (criterion ii)

blocks.en: Two alternative methods were implemented to reconstruct fiber instances from candidate ridges grouped into fiber fragments (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 采用了两种替代方法,从被组合成纤维碎片的候选脊重建纤维情况(图3)。

blocks.en: Marker-controlled watershed [ 24 , 68 ] : The candidate ridges belonging to retained fiber fragments were rasterized as one-pixel-wide markers, with a unique label assigned to each fragment. The distance transform was normalized as D ​ T n = D ​ T / 255 DT_{n}=DT/255 and converted into a watershed elevation image E = 1 − D ​ T n E=1-DT_{n} . Segmentation was restricted to a mask obtained by thresholding distance-field gradient magnitude, ‖ 𝐠 ‖ ≥ g min \|\mathbf{g}\|\geq g_{\min} (default 0.5), and adding the centerline mask dilated twice using a 3 × 3 3\times 3 square kernel. Watershed segmentation was performed within this mask using eight-neighbor connectivity, allowing regions to grow outward from the centerlines while preserving separate fragment labels.

The union of disks belonging to the same fragment defined its segmented region (Fig. 3 ).

blocks.en: Before instance reconstruction, fragments were retained only if their longest constituent centerline was at least 3 3 pixels long. The remaining fragments were ranked by total accepted measurement-centerline length, and the lowest-ranked 1 % 1\% fragments were removed.

blocks.en: Gradient quality was assessed within the full-radius expansion of each fragment, excluding centerline pixels, using the median deviation of the smoothed distance-field gradient magnitude from unity. Fragments with fewer than eight valid evaluation pixels were discarded, while additional rank-based filtering by gradient quality was disabled.

blocks.en: After instance reconstruction, an optional foreground-probability map was used to remove false-positive segments. Regions with a mean foreground probability below 0.5 0.5 were discarded. This final filtering was applied identically to both segmentation methods and omitted when no foreground-probability output was available.
blocks.zh: 实例重建后,使用可选的前景概率图去除假阳性片段. 平均前景概率低于0.5的区域被丢弃。 这种最后的过滤被同样应用于两种分解方法,并在没有前景概率输出时省略.

blocks.en: Quantitative analysis
blocks.zh: 定量分析

blocks.en: Centerlines were sampled for measurements at a user-defined spacing. At each sampling point 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} , the initial fiber normal was estimated from the local centerline tangent and refined over three iterations using distance-transform gradients sampled on opposite sides of the centerline, at half the central distance-transform value. Normal directions were adjusted to maintain continuity along each centerline.

blocks.en: The local radius was estimated with Eq. ( 2 ), using distance-transform values sampled at δ = 1 \delta=1 px on both sides of the centerline. Local fiber orientation was calculated perpendicular to the refined normal and expressed in the axial interval [ − 90 ∘ , 90 ∘ ] [-90^{\circ},90^{\circ}] . The resulting diameter and orientation measurements were used to calculate distributions and summary statistics.

The comparison used the ten SEM images of the instance-segmentation benchmark described below (five with randomly oriented and five with aligned fibers; none used for training). In each image, ten fiber diameters were measured in ImageJ with the straight-line tool, drawing each line from edge to edge across the fiber, perpendicular to its axis, on clearly identifiable fiber segments away from crossings and fiber ends. Line length, angle and bounding rectangle were exported to perform automatic DT measurements at the same locations. Because Fiberpose samples on the DT ridge, the sampling center 𝐜 \mathbf{c} was set to the position of the maximal DT value along the line, and the unit vector 𝐧 \mathbf{n} along the line was used as the sampling direction. The apex estimate was calculated as d = 2 ​ D ​ ( 𝐜 ) d=2D(\mathbf{c}) and the corrected estimate with Eq. ( 2 ) at 𝐱 = 𝐜 \mathbf{x}=\mathbf{c} and δ = 1 \delta=1 px. Each sampling position was rounded to the nearest pixel, without interpolation. Errors were computed as DT-derived minus manual diameter and summarized per image as bias and MAE. Images were treated as the experimental unit: per-image MAE of the apex and corrected estimates were compared with a one-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( n = 10 n=10 images); the test was one-sided because the correction is designed to remove the underestimation of the apex estimate. The 95% confidence interval of the residual bias of the corrected estimate was calculated from the ten per-image mean biases, using the t t distribution with 9 degrees of freedom. The perpendicularity of the manual lines was checked against the local fiber normal.

blocks.en: The orientation index (OI) was calculated from the sampled fiber orientations as

blocks.en: Instance segmentation was evaluated on ten SEM images (512 × \times 512 pixels) of fibers, including five images with randomly oriented fibers and five with aligned fibers. The images were drawn from public sources: the DiameterJ [ 22 ] and GIFT [ 9 ] datasets, a collection of SEM images of climbing ropes [ 26 ] , and four open-access articles [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . None of the benchmark images were used for training. The test images were manually annotated with three classes: fiber instances, background, and ignore regions. Fiberpose in watershed and ridge-expansion segmentation modes was compared with Cellpose-SAM [ 19 ] , used as distributed on Hugging Face, and with uncurated outputs of the SAM2 tiny model [ 31 , 32 ] in automatic mask generation mode.

blocks.en: Diameter-measurement accuracy was evaluated on 20 SEM images ranging in size from 384 × 302 384\times 302 to 1584 × 1455 1584\times 1455 pixels. The benchmark included both high-quality, high-contrast images with clearly defined fibers and more challenging images characterized by faint boundaries, non-uniform contrast, blur, or reduced image quality. The images were drawn from public sources: the DiameterJ [ 22 ] and GIFT [ 9 ] datasets and open-access articles [ 36 , 71 , 72 , 73 , 41 , 74 , 75 ] . None of the benchmark images were used for training.
blocks.zh: 对20幅SEM图像进行了测量精度评价,其大小从384×302384\时302到1584×14551584\时1455像素. 该基准既包括具有明确界定的纤维的高质量、高混凝土图像,也包括以模糊边界、非统一对比、模糊或图像质量下降为特征的更具挑战性的图像。 这些图像来自公共来源:DiameterJ [22]和GIFT [9]数据集和开放查阅文章[36,71,72,73,41,74,75]. 没有任何基准图像用于培训。

blocks.en: Measurements obtained with Fiberpose in its default and strict modes were compared with those obtained using DiameterJ [ 7 ] , Fibar [ 35 ] and GIFT [ 9 ] , with manual measurements serving as the reference. Manual diameter measurements were performed in ImageJ using an overlaid grid consisting of three horizontal lines (top, middle, and bottom), each containing ten sampling points. At each point, the diameter was measured on a clearly identifiable segment of the fiber whose boundary was closest to the sampling point, yielding 30 measurements per image. For each image, the relative absolute error (%) between the diameter estimated by each automated method and the manually measured median diameter was calculated and compared across methods. Fiberpose , DiameterJ and Fibar estimates were per-image medians, whereas GIFT reports the mean of a Gaussian distribution fitted to its diameter measurements; this value was used as reported by the tool. DiameterJ and Fibar were run with their default settings. GIFT was run with filtering angles of 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} , 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} and 135 ∘ 135^{\circ} . Negative diameters returned by GIFT (two images) were treated as failed fits and excluded from the comparisons.

blocks.en: Because Fibar does not export intermediate segmentation results, its segmentation was reimplemented for visualization following the classical image-processing pipeline described by Moor et al. [ 35 ] . Grayscale SEM images were denoised with a 3 × 3 3\times 3 Kuwahara filter, binarized with Huang’s automatic thresholding method and post-processed with a 15 × 15 15\times 15 median filter to obtain binary fiber masks. The reimplemented masks were used only for illustration (Fig. 8 c); all Fibar diameter estimates were obtained with the original tool.
blocks.zh: 由于Fibar不导出中间分解结果,其分解在Moor等人描述的古典图像处理管道之后被重新执行以可视化. [35]. 灰度的SEM图像用3×3 3\时的3 Kuwahara滤波器解析,用黄氏的自动阈值法二进制,后用15×15 15\时的15中位滤波器进行处理,以获得二进制纤维口罩. 重新使用的口罩仅用于插图(图8 c);所有Fibar直径估计都是用原始工具获得的.

blocks.en: Orientation measurements on the same 20-image morphometry benchmark were compared with those produced by OrientationJ [ 25 ] and Directionality [ 37 ] . Both tools were run with their default settings. No manual orientation ground truth was generated. All methods used the same axial-angle convention and histogram binning. Agreement was evaluated using differences in orientation index and Wasserstein distances between the corresponding angular distributions.
blocks.zh: 将相同的20-图像测尸基准的定向测量与定向J[25]和定向[37]编制的基准进行比较。 这两个工具都按默认设置运行。 没有生成手动定向地面真相。 所有方法都使用相同的轴角常规和直方图的插图. 对协议的评估采用了定向指数和相应角分布之间的瓦瑟斯坦距离的差异。

blocks.en: Images were treated as independent experimental units, with measurements paired by image identifier. All comparisons between methods used paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on per-image values, implemented in SciPy [ 76 ] : instance-segmentation recall, precision, IoU, NSD and HD95 ( n = 10 n=10 images; exact test); relative absolute diameter errors ( n = 20 n=20 images; n = 18 n=18 for GIFT ); orientation-agreement measures (absolute OI differences and Wasserstein distances) between method pairs ( n = 20 n=20 images); and per-image MAE of the apex and corrected estimates ( n = 10 n=10 images; exact test). Tests were two-sided, except for the comparison of apex and corrected estimates, which was one-sided as described above. Statistical significance was defined as p < 0.05 p<0.05 , without correction for multiple comparisons.
blocks.zh: 图像被作为独立的实验单位处理,测量结果与图像识别符成对. 在SciPy [76] 中实施的每幅图像值的对称威尔考克斯签名排名测试方法之间的所有比较:实例分类召回,精确度,IoU,NSD和HD95(n=10n=10图像;精确测试);相对绝对直径误差(n=20n=20图像;n=18n=18图像为GIFT);方法对数(n=20n=20图像)之间的定向协议测量(绝对OI差异和Wasserstein距离);以及偶数的超像MAE和校正估计(n=10n=10图像;精确测试). 试验是双面的,但最高值与更正后的估计数的比较除外,如上所述是单面的. 统计意义被定义为p < 0.05 p < 0.05,没有更正多次比较。

blocks.en: The reference implementation is in Python (PyTorch, NumPy, OpenCV, scikit-image) with an optional PyQt6 GUI for interactive use and batch/CLI for headless runs. The GUI supports GPU inference, DT visualization, segmentation overlays, diameter/orientation histograms, and batch processing, see Figure 5 . The source code with installation instructions is freely available on GitHub https://github.com/vikba/fiberpose
